2317-2921-6664-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

2023-4742-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5686-8175.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

671-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2511-7804--5.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
2511-7804--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.

670-1619-3668-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Dack's Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

5641-6996-7173.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6996-7173.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

2757-4222-7065.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the basic Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1169-4091-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7185.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Belonging, adding {C}{C}.
When Belonging dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-5223-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3459-3755-5078-6766.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-1753-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2416-3899-4365-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1818-2173-5010-5686.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2173-5010-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

647-1402-2644-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4484-4871-5643-5686-6710.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5643-5686-6710.notablePrerequisites: There are two cards exiled by The Kenriths' Royal Funeral.
4484-4871-5643-5686-6710.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5643-5686-6710.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

586-997-1796-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

225-880-6528.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
You control an additional creature.
225-880-6528.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1750-2793-3698-5261-5740.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Assassin that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-2793-3698-5261-5740.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, causing target player to mill three cards.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using an Assassin, triggering Layla Hassan, returning Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
When Ugin's Nexus enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

341-779-4970-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3536-4311-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

598-5147-5173.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

2913-4017-4499-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Boulderbranch Golem.
Boulderbranch Golem enters the battlefield, causing you to gain six life.
Cryptic Trilobite triggers, putting six +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

851-1558-3529-4231.notablePrerequisites: Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
851-1558-3529-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating two Treasure tokens, two Food tokens, and two Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

643-2034-2577-3806.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard for {0}.
Repeat.

1283-1518-1987-2556.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1283-1518-1987-2556.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

406-731-1525-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Corrupted Conscience and Tandem Lookout is paired with Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
406-731-1525-4298.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Borborygmos triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
